related.title: Huffman：前綴碼、成本與可解碼性
related.titleEn: Huffman: prefix codes, costs and decodability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付union-trace.csv與BFS oracle；不把小fixture的步數當漸近複雜度證明。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver union-trace.csv and a BFS oracle; small-fixture steps are not an asymptotic proof. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫每次heap合併及完整二元樹，從root產生碼；逐symbol驗證沒有碼是另一碼前綴。
related.differenceEn: Trace heap merges and the binary tree, derive codes from the root and verify no code prefixes another.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
disjoint-set追蹤等價類；union兩個已同根元素不減少分量數。路徑壓縮改樹形但不改連通關係。
本課數值核對：6-3 = 3 components；另一項核對：3-1 = 2 components。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

Huffman反覆合併最小頻率建前綴樹；相同頻率可有不同碼字但相同最佳成本，驗收不應固定某一位元串。
本課數值核對：2+4+9 = 15 bits；另一項核對：9*2 = 18 bits。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Disjoint sets track equivalence classes; union within an existing class does not reduce component count. Path compression changes shape, not connectivity.
Numeric audit: 6-3 = 3 components; second audit: 3-1 = 2 components. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Huffman repeatedly merges minimum frequencies into a prefix tree; ties can produce different codes with equal optimal cost, so acceptance should not fix one bit pattern.
Numeric audit: 2+4+9 = 15 bits; second audit: 9*2 = 18 bits. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: XML：樹狀結構、命名空間與外部實體
related.titleEn: XML: trees, namespaces and external entities
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付union-trace.csv與BFS oracle；不把小fixture的步數當漸近複雜度證明。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver union-trace.csv and a BFS oracle; small-fixture steps are not an asymptotic proof. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫root與三children，儲存expanded names而非prefix字串；保留解析器安全設定與輸入上限。
related.differenceEn: Draw the root and three children, storing expanded names rather than prefixes, with parser security settings and input limits recorded.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
disjoint-set追蹤等價類；union兩個已同根元素不減少分量數。路徑壓縮改樹形但不改連通關係。
本課數值核對：6-3 = 3 components；另一項核對：3-1 = 2 components。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

XML名稱的namespace URI與local name構成語意身分；prefix只是局部別名。外部實體解析政策須明確且預設不取外部資源。
本課數值核對：3+1 = 4 element_nodes；另一項核對：2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Disjoint sets track equivalence classes; union within an existing class does not reduce component count. Path compression changes shape, not connectivity.
Numeric audit: 6-3 = 3 components; second audit: 3-1 = 2 components. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Namespace URI plus local name identifies an XML name; prefixes are local aliases. External-entity policy must be explicit and default to no external fetching.
Numeric audit: 3+1 = 4 element_nodes; second audit: 2-1 = 1 redundant_prefixes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
